right.scene: Samuel in a long undyed linen tunic and deep blue wool cloak, tipping a horn of oil over the kneeling young David; Jesse and the brothers Eliab, Abinadab and Shammah standing in a loose ring, the horn of oil in Samuel's hand, faint radiance or light hovering over David

left.scene: Moses at the head of the Israelite people, walking forward with hand lowered across the parted water; Women and children, herdsmen with flocks, a few men carrying bundles; water walls glistening with spray and moving wind-torn surfaces; no Egyptians present

right.scene: Moses standing before the rock, rod raised overhead in a striking pose; Aaron in priestly garments beside Moses, the congregation and livestock gathering near the flow, tents at the edge of the camp

left.scene: Moses in plain linen cloak, standing at the water's edge with his arm extended out over the sea; Strong east wind blowing spray and moving cloud; radiant cloud and pillar of fire spreading pale gold across the wind and the parted water; Israelites in woven tunics and cloaks gathered on the shore behind Moses

right.scene: Moses seated on a stone on the hillside, arms raised and supported by Aaron and Hur; Aaron on Moses' right and Hur on his left, bracing his arms; Israelite warriors with shields and staves fighting in the valley; Amalekite fighters in leather and cloth wraps

left.scene: David, a young shepherd, mid-release with a sling, arm extended after the throw.; Goliath's bronze helmet and scale armor, his spear and shield dropping from his grasp; Philistine warriors and Israelite soldiers watching from the slopes at a distance.
